titulo: Rahab asked on behalf of her family
resumen: Rahab asked the spies to swear by the Lord that they would deal kindly with her whole family. A letter about bringing our loved ones before God.

versos.texto: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;
and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”

reflexion: Rahab has already hidden the spies and acknowledged the Lord. Now she makes a request. She asks them to swear to her by the Lord that they will deal kindly with her family, as she has dealt kindly with them. And she asks them for a true sign, something sure to hold on to.

The story takes place in a time of war, and Rahab asks that her loved ones be delivered from death. Notice the list: her father, her mother, her brothers, her sisters and all that they have. In a moment of fear, Rahab doesn't think only of herself. She thinks of her whole household.

In the verses that follow, the spies answer her and give her their word. Maybe you too are carrying worry about someone in your family today. You can bring your loved ones before the Lord, one by one, by name.
You don't need to have all the answers. It is enough to bring him what worries you. And if that worry keeps you awake at night, talking with someone you trust is also part of care.
dedicatoria: This letter is for you, who think of your loved ones before yourself. Your love for them also has a place in prayer.
oracion: Lord, thank you for the mercy you show us every day. Today we bring our family before you, each one by name. Watch over them with your love. In Jesus' name, amen.
